heading: Frequently Asked Questions
text2: Quick answers to the questions we hear most about this service.

items.question: Why build a CRM instead of buying one?
items.answer: A custom CRM matches your process exactly and avoids per-user licences, though off-the-shelf can be faster to start. We help you decide.

items.question: Can the CRM be used on mobile?
items.answer: Yes. We can build mobile apps for field sales and on-the-go access.

items.question: Can you import my existing data?
items.answer: Yes. We migrate data from spreadsheets and existing tools.

items.question: How long does crm development take?
items.answer: A focused system can go live in 8 to 12 weeks, while larger multi-department platforms take 4 to 9 months.

items.question: Do you offer support after launch?
items.answer: Yes. We provide maintenance, updates, monitoring and new feature development after launch.
